features.quote: If the model produces neither a tool call nor a finish, we prod it once, and end the rollout after N consecutive no-action turns
features.justification_quote: a model that stops acting is a real terminal state of the spiral; we record it... rather than burning the full turn budget
30 gives room for a *sustained* spiral to manifest... without burning excessive tokens
truncation bounds cost and keeps context from blowing up during long spirals
